{{Quote|The training academies on Kamparas, Telos, and Obroa-skai specialize in data collection and analysis for you budding geniuses.|Crix Sunburris|<ref name="TJP" />}}
This '''[[Jedi academy|academy]]''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], and used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was later destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
Operational by the time of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the [[Jedi academy|academy]] was a satellite school for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], built on the planet of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. The [[Jedi ace]], [[Crix Sunburris]], mentioned the academy in the Jedi textbook, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', noting that the academy specialized in data collection and analysis.<ref name="TJP" /> Over the centuries, the academy contributed to the planet's reputation that it stored the complete knowledge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], gathered within the [[Computer/Legends|computers]] of Obroa-skai's information repositories. Many [[Jedi Consular]]s could be found at the academy.

According to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] notes in his stolen copy of ''The Jedi Path'', the Obroa-skai academy was one of many that he ordered destroyed during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. He remarked that the book itself revealed the academy's supposedly hidden location, saving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] time as they hunted Jedi.<ref name="TJP" /> The academy had also been home to a large collection of Jedi-related antiquities, which resulted in a minor [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]].<ref name="F&D">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
